description: This file defines an interface 'IdentifiableStreamingMessage' which extends 'StreamingMessage'. It provides a method to retrieve an identifier string for streaming messages, used for correlation purposes.

classes.name: IdentifiableStreamingMessage
classes.description: Interface representing a streaming message with an identifiable component, allowing correlation of acknowledgments.

methods.name: asIdentifierString
methods.description: Returns the identifier for this streaming message, used for correlation.
